title: Sectioned Lists: Grouping by Letter
hints: `Dictionary(grouping:by:)` builds sections from a key function.
Key: uppercased first letter, or `#` for non-letters.
Sort keys with `(isHash ? 1 : 0, key)` tuples so `#` comes last.
jsBridge: Grouping into sections is `Dictionary(grouping:)` plus sorted keys, then `ForEach` over sections. The same data prep as a React `SectionList`, where the view just renders pre-shaped data.
